description: Find companies worldwide by name in the official GLEIF register of legal entities: legal name, LEI, country, registered address, company-register number, legal form and status, best match first, plus matching US-listed companies with ticker and SEC CIK. Costs USD 0.005 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base); calls that fail are not charged.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code to narrow the search, e.g. IN
